scope: Public HTTP harness validation at depths 0 and 4096, not full-depth execution or quality characterization.
protocol: Gufo pinned prompt/calibration/prefix-reply/retry recipe with an additional untimed hipEngine common-prefix checkpoint.
timing_scope: Native backend wall includes scheduler waits; not GPU interval cost.

launch.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
BASE=/tmp/qwen38fn-gufo-20261021
ENV_PREFIX="$HOME/miniforge3/envs/therock"
PY="$ENV_PREFIX/bin/python"
ROOT=$("$PY" -m rocm_sdk path --root)
SITE=$("$PY" -c 'import site; print(site.getsitepackages()[0])')
if [[ ! -f "$BASE/hipcc-version.txt" ]]; then
  "$ROOT/bin/hipcc" --version > "$BASE/hipcc-version.txt"
fi
exec env -i HOME="$HOME" USER="$USER" \
  PATH="$ENV_PREFIX/bin:$ROOT/bin:$ROOT/lib/llvm/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" \
  LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$SITE/_rocm_sdk_core/lib:$SITE/_rocm_sdk_devel/lib:$SITE/_rocm_sdk_libraries/lib" \
  HIP_PATH="$ROOT" ROCM_PATH="$ROOT" HIP_LIB_PATH="$ROOT/lib" \
  HIP_INCLUDE_PATH="$ROOT/include" HIP_DEVICE_LIB_PATH="$ROOT/lib/llvm/amdgcn/bitcode" \
  HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 \
  HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE="$BASE/hipcc-version.txt" \
  PYTHONPATH="$PWD" "$PY" "$@"
